title: alsine rotundifolia
intro: Alsine rotundifolia, commonly known as round-leaved saxifrage, is a plant species in the Saxifragaceae family. The plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Alsine rotundifolia include its ability to soothe digestive issues, calm respiratory problems, and exhibit antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
